procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the ten pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (banner 'Official Recapitulation 2026 General Election'; cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/pike/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (11/11).
structure_note: Ten-page shape: p1 the certification/signature page (four of five commissioners signed, 13th November 2026, scanned sideways); p2+p3+p4 = table A over the county's TWENTY-FIVE numbered precincts (11 columns (01) New Hope..(11) St. James, then (12) Navilla..(22) Church of Christ, then (23) West McComb/(24) Our Lady of Hope/(25) Osyka City Hall + TOTAL) carrying Senate, House 3, CoA 4 Position 2, and Chancery 4 Places 1-3; p5+p6+p7 = table B over the same column split carrying the CARRY tail of Chancery 4 Place 3 (Ashunda Hampton -- the race's second candidate, printing headerless on table B because the Place 3 header printed on table A above Debbra K. Halford's row, exactly as Franklin/Jefferson/Wilkinson print their own Hampton rows), Circuit Court 6-3's section (David H. Strong Jr.), and the LOCAL table (whose section list follows); p8+p9+p10 = the carried tail of '1 - South Pike School Board 1' (Eva Andrews, Willie 'Coach' McCray). The table-B sections print with their header boxes at/near their row blocks: 'Pike-County Court Judge' prints MID-BLOCK between Strong's and Brewer's rows (a two-candidate county judge race -- the Tippah Place-3 mid-block pattern), 'Supervisor 02-Supervisor District 2' and the two school-board headers print ABOVE their rows, and '1 - South Pike School Board 1' also printed as each of p5/p6/p7's bottom boxes. Races (in scope): U.S. Senate (Colom/Hyde-Smith/Pinkins); US House Of Rep 03-3rd Congressional District (Michael A. Chiaradio DEM, Michael Guest REP, Erik KIEHLE LIB -- Pike joins Winston in spelling the Libertarian 'Kiehle', where the other sixteen D3 counties print 'Klehle'); Court Of Appeals 04-District 4 Position 2 (David McCarty -- the CoA 4 roster alone, names identical, FOURTEENTH county); Chancery Court 4-Chancery District 04 Place 1 (E. Vincent Davis), Place 2 (Wayne Smith), Place 3 (Debbra K. Halford, Ashunda Hampton) -- the Chancery 4 roster Adams/Amite/Franklin/Wilkinson/Jefferson print, names identical; Circuit Court 6-3-Circuit Court 6-3 (David H. Strong Jr. -- the sub-place label family Bolivar's 11-1/11-2 and Jefferson's 7-5 use, printed here alone: no other county in this print carries Pike's Place 3 sub-district). Printed totals: Colom 7494, Hyde-Smith 5209, Pinkins 199, Chiaradio 7159, Guest 5545, Kiehle 125, McCarty 10460, Davis 10414, Smith 10507, Halford 6393, Hampton 5397, Strong 10722.
operator_rows_note: All 12 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3+p4 cells + the p4 printed TOTAL, Hampton's and Strong's rows carry p5+p6+p7 cells + the p7 printed TOTAL (both races cover every Pike precinct on this print -- no X-cells in any in-scope row). Hampton's row is the section-continuation of Chancery Court 4 Place 3 across the table A/table B boundary: the Place 3 header printed on table A above Halford's row, so the race's second candidate prints on table B without its header. The local rows (Strong's and Brewer's county judge race, the five Supervisor District 2 candidates Alicia 'Ms. Kitty' Forrest/DeLorean Hall/Jack Martin/Gable 'Gabe' Stewart/Ardemis Wesley III, Evelle Thomas Dillon, Chris Richardson, Eva Andrews, Willie 'Coach' McCray) contribute no parse rows.

local_note: p5-p10 carry six LOCAL sections: 'Pike-County Court Judge' (David H. Strong Jr., David Lee Brewer -- countywide, its header printing mid-block), 'Supervisor 02-Supervisor District 2' (Alicia 'Ms. Kitty' Forrest, DeLorean Hall, Jack Martin, Gable 'Gabe' Stewart, Ardemis Wesley III -- X-celled outside Take Dominion/St Mary/Fernwood/Magnolia/Braswell), 'McComb School Board (Outside)-McComb School Board' (Evelle Thomas Dillon), '1 - North Pike School Board 1-North Pike School Board, District 1' (Chris Richardson) and '1 - South Pike School Board 1-South Pike School Board, District 1' (Eva Andrews, Willie 'Coach' McCray -- rows carried headerless onto p8-p10) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows. Chancery 4's printed Places are 1-3; Circuit 6's printed Places are the single 6-3 sub-place section.

accepted_roster_divergences.note: A one-letter name-spelling variance across the district's SEMS prints: Pike's recap (like Winston's) prints the Libertarian's surname as 'Erik Kiehle' while the sixteen other District-3 counties print 'Erik Klehle' (Pike's second letter carries its tittle at 600 dpi -- verified 2026-11-21 against the p2 row label). Kept as printed per source fidelity: Pike's and Winston's CSVs record Kiehle; the other counties' CSVs record Klehle.

A multi-place spread the seat-blind roster gate cannot compare: District 6's Places print DISJOINT rosters, with no county carrying the union. Adams and Amite print Places 1-2 (Carmen Brooks Drake P1, Debra W. Blackwell P2), Franklin only Place 2 (Blackwell), Wilkinson only Place 1 (Drake), and Pike only place 6-3 -- David H. Strong Jr., the sub-district's own race (Pike's sub-place label 'Circuit Court 6-3-Circuit Court 6-3', the same sub-place label family as Bolivar's 11-1/11-2 and Jefferson's 7-5). Each Place elects its own judge; each county keeps its own printed print.
